title: OTWD site as a GeoJSON feature
description: A site as one GeoJSON Feature (RFC 7946), as the API serves it with Accept: application/geo+json (properties in the compact form) and as GeoJSON bulk downloads hold it (properties in the full form). The geometry is a Point built from the site's published location and nothing else, so a site whose location is sensitive carries the same generalised coordinates in its geometry as in its properties (ADR 0045). A merged site has no location, so its geometry is null. tools/validate.py checks that the geometry equals the location.
